title: Review: kithctl, kith-peer, kith-attach
notes: Maintainer risk: HIGH — two P0 bugs in kithctl watch make the feature non-functional on any deployed kithd (wrong accountId, missing hasMoreChanges pagination). One P1 security issue in kith-attach (world-readable temp files). One P1 deployment issue in kith-peer (Headscale hostnames blocked). Confidence: 85% chance no additional P0 bugs missed. Uncertainty: did not review kith-peer integration test harness wiring in detail; did not trace what kithd returns when accountId='me' (could be notFound or accountNotFound, but either way notifications fail). Would raise confidence: run kithctl watch against a live kithd and observe the error response to confirm severity of KITH-60f2.1.
